statement: NexysVHDL Toolchain 1.0 is an aggregation of separate third-party programs and data, each under its own license. It is NOT licensed under NexysVHDL's Apache License 2.0; that license covers only NexysVHDL's own code and the NexysVHDL-authored files of the toolchain (manifest, pinned Apio configuration, shims, placeholders, notices).

nexysvhdl.appliesTo: NexysVHDL's own code and data (the VSIX) and the NexysVHDL-authored files inside Toolchain 1.0: toolchain-manifest.json, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, apio/remote-config/*, apio/packages/installed_packages.json, shims/*, placeholder READMEs

digilent.policy: Not redistributed. NexysVHDL does not include, mirror or download Digilent Adept Runtime, Adept Utilities (djtgcfg) or Digilent drivers. On Windows it detects the user's official Digilent installation and points to Digilent's official download page.

GPL-2.0.action: Provide the license text and the complete corresponding source of the binaries (source shipped alongside, GPLv2 section 3(a)); keep notices.

GPL-3.0.action: Provide the license text and the complete Corresponding Source (GPLv3 section 6(a)/(d): alongside the object code or from the same place); keep notices.

LGPL-2.0.action: Provide the license text and the complete source of the library; keep notices; allow replacement of the library (shared libraries are shipped as separate files).

LGPL-3.0.action: Provide LGPL-3.0 and GPL-3.0 texts and the Corresponding Source of the library; keep notices; libraries are shipped as replaceable shared libraries/frameworks.

EUPL-1.2.action: Provide the license; provide the source or indicate a repository where it is freely available (EUPL-1.2 article 5). NexysVHDL ships the source.

EPL-1.0.action: Provide the license; state that source code is available and how to obtain it (EPL-1.0 section 3). NexysVHDL ships the source.

MPL-2.0.action: Provide the license; inform recipients how to obtain the Source Code Form (MPL-2.0 section 3.2).

GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1.action: Provide GPL-3.0 and the GCC Runtime Library Exception texts. The exception (section 1) permits propagating Target Code formed by combining the Runtime Library with Independent Modules under terms of the distributor's choice; the corresponding source of the runtime itself is not required by the exception text. NexysVHDL still records its origin.

Apache-2.0.action: Provide the license text and any NOTICE file the component carries.

Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception.action: Provide the license text (including the LLVM exceptions).

ISC.action: Keep the copyright and permission notice.

MIT.action: Keep the copyright and permission notice.

BSD-2-Clause.action: Keep the copyright notice, conditions and disclaimer in the documentation.

BSD-3-Clause.action: Keep the copyright notice, conditions and disclaimer in the documentation.

LicenseRef-Berkeley-permissive.action: Keep the copyright notice and the permission paragraph (UC Berkeley-style notice used by ABC and AVY).

PSF-2.0.action: Keep the PSF license agreement and copyright notice.

Zlib.action: Keep the notice; do not misrepresent origin.

BSL-1.0.action: Keep the license with source distributions; binaries need no notice (still listed).

LicenseRef-Microsoft-Redistributable.action: Microsoft Visual C++ / Universal CRT runtime files redistributed as part of a third-party binary bundle; terms are Microsoft's redistributable terms granted to that bundle's producer. Review required.

placeholder.reason: Apio 1.6.0 requires a "drivers" package on windows-amd64 (apio/resources/packages.jsonc, restricted-to-platforms) before it runs any command, but only "apio drivers ..." uses it and NexysVHDL never runs that: NexysVHDL installs no USB drivers (Windows programming uses the official Digilent Adept support).
evidence: apio/resources/packages.jsonc at Apio 9fbb279c: drivers restricted to windows-amd64, env adds %p/bin to PATH only.

PE import scan of all 655 PE files of Toolchain 1.0 (scripts/compliance/pe-imports.mjs): no file outside the package imports a DLL that only the drivers package provides (it provides none used elsewhere).
Installed-VSIX process traces (Phase 4B standard and hostile paths, and this phase): zadig, lsusb, lsftdi, ftdi_eeprom and serial_install never run.

serial_install.exe is PJRC's "Serial Installer" for Teensy ((C) 2014 PJRC.COM, LLC; http://www.pjrc.com/teensy/; Comodo code-signed), committed as a prebuilt binary to FPGAwars/tools-drivers (package/bin, first commit 2025-06-09) with no license file.
Experiment: Apio 1.6.0 with an empty drivers folder and a matching installed_packages.json entry reports "All Apio packages are installed OK" and runs with all network access blocked.

unresolved.description: The Windows oss-cad-suite package bundles 161 third-party DLLs that are not covered by its license/ folder: Fedora MinGW (mingw64-*) RPM payloads from YosysHQ's Fedora build container (dnf install, unpinned). Their build strings show Fedora MinGW GCC 13.1.1-4.fc39 / 13.2.1-5.fc39 (some fc37/fc38). Versions from the binaries include Qt 5.15.11, GTK 3.24.38, GLib 2.77.1, OpenSSL 3.0.9, libusb 1.0.24, Python 3.11.6, ICU 73.
unresolved.copyleft: Includes LGPL (Qt 5 LGPL-3.0, GTK/GLib/Pango/ATK/Cairo/gdk-pixbuf LGPL-2.x, gettext libintl/libasprintf, iconv, fribidi, libidn2, ...) and GPL (GNU readline 8 + history GPL-3.0, gettext tools, libtermcap, dbus ...) libraries. GNU readline, libtermcap, libintl and iconv are loaded by Yosys, which NexysVHDL runs.
unresolved.missing: The exact Fedora package builds (name-version-release) are not recorded in the package or by YosysHQ (release 2026-03-24 publishes binaries only), so the corresponding source (Fedora SRPMs) and each library's license cannot be pinned from authoritative records.
unresolved.resolution: Either (a) map each DLL to its exact Fedora build (Koji) and add the SRPMs as pinned sources, (b) obtain the corresponding source/build manifest from YosysHQ (original distributor), or (c) in Toolchain 1.1, prune the oss-cad-suite payload to the files the Nexys A7 flow uses (Yosys and its runtime closure), then resolve the much smaller remaining set (readline, termcap, intl, iconv, tcl, libffi, zlib, Python 3.11, GCC runtime).
